review_description: Were good to start with, but after installation when problems arose they wouldn’t respond to phone calls, messages or emails. Had an ongoing issue with the inverter going offline after many months of complaints goodwe  agreed to replace home kit. Now I can’t get hold them, phone calls are answered what sounds like a phillipino call centre, no one responds to the messages. The original contact we had was Matt , he never returns calls or messages. No wonder they changed their name

Received a contact email very quickly. We discussed my needs and the options available by phone and shortly thereafter I received a comprehensive info package and quote.We arranged an installation time that suited me, rather than the company. The team arrived on time (a miracle in this area!), and were proactive in making sure the process was painless. Both technicians were super polite, invited questions and gave me options where appropriate. The whole process took only four hours and they cleaned up nicely before leaving.After-sales service included their staff forwarding all the necessary paperwork to Ausgrid etc on my behalf and fine-tuning the Fronius backend. I had a couple of questions about how to get the best out of the system and future battery portions, and these were answered quickly and comprehensively.Always Energy are super professional and provide an outstanding service at a very reasonable price. I recommend them most warmly.

Installers were always early, and concentrated on the job. Very helpful with information on the Inverter Controls, and the paperwork following installation. They also took care of the grid connection paperwork.

From the sales to the installation communication was extremely good and this was a very pleasant surprise. Melissa from the sales team was quick to follow up on the questions that I had and Jose on the Operations side worked hard to keep me informed on the instal schedule. My initial instal date was moved and this was a minor annoyance but Jose was on to it to ensure that the instal was locked in a week later. He followed up to ensure that things were on schedule and reassure me. I have installed several units over the years on my properties but Mitch and Zac were the best of the installers I have experienced. Mitch was communicative , knowledgeable and professional. A very good experience and top marks to the Bila (Always) Team.Greg MPort Macquarie

Great experience. Unlike the "Marketing Companies" that try to sell you crap systems this company listened & gave great advice. Old school values with old school service. My mind is at ease as they are genuine trustworthy people who are going to continue to build a great name for themselves in the industry. I can not speak highly enough of them & I'm extremely happy with my system. I chose a quality system & their pricing was equal to or better than many other quotes I received.
Quick service smooth Install ,Waiting on Follow up on Teething trouble with Monitoring Inverter Hopefully Sorted Soon .

No one came out to my property to quote in person, all done by Google earth. I don't know if this normal practice or not. I think it is as no other company's came out either.Initial communication was good., but settling on an install date was bit undecisive. I called them several times for updates. Finally called to say install would be the next day, a week earlier than discussed, so I was very happy about that. 3 weeks after deposit paid. I would have liked to be contacted a bit more for updates.They 2 guys that installed were great. Got stuck into it and seemed to really know their stuff. very helpful and explained anything I wanted to know.Over all. I am very happy and would recommend them.

The whole process was easy and stress free.  I found all the companies solar quotes recommended were easy to deal with, professional and there was no hard sell tactics from anyone.  All the quotes were reasonably close and I had all companies quote on exactly the same components so it was apples for apples.  It came down to supporting a local company who had a great business model, service, communication and warranty.  The installation crew were friendly, professional and worked very hard and did a great job and cleaned the site on completion.  This was a replacement/upgrade from an old system so everything was already in place with the electricity company.

The service provided was prompt and efficient from quoting stage right through to the installation. I was hospitalised during the installation but the whole process was seamless. Other residents of the village where we live who also used Always Energy and all seemed equally satisfied with their service.

Matt was easy to deal with. Organised an install date less than 2 wks after making a deposit. The install crew Doug and the boys turned up and done a flawless job. Went beyond my expectations to do a thorough job. Well pleased and would recommend this company.

They told me what I wanted to hear, however they lied on one occasion stating the installer would be someone from their company,  secondly they did not disclose that there was an export limitation of 5kw in my area, and now they will not answer my calls.Installation was ok, although one of the strings had not been connected properly and system was not operating correctlyCustomer service was ok up until I had issues with system. I now have to go to fair trade and I will be seeking legal advice
Punctual on all aspects from quote to installation . Easy to deal with. No pressure to buy.

Matt was great to deal with and went the extra mile when I asked questions regarding 3 phase inverters.Phil and the crew who performed the install didn't cut any corners. I will be recommending Always Energy to my friends who are considering going solar.

Quote process was good. Roof photo with suggested location of panels was helpful. Installer complied with request to place panels away from roof edge. 2 workers worked efficiently & looked like they knew what they were doing. Appreciated organisation of grid connection by Origin contractor. This was done very efficiently.

Quick to send out bill for deposit and final payment.Have been contacting them for months regarding our WiFi system not working,and panels have been placed over ridge capping,which can potentially void our warranty.I should not have to be the one chasing them up.Would not recommend this company.

The sales process was OK and they were fast in getting the bill for the deposit and the final payment out so they could be paid. The install date was postponed twice with very little notice provided. The second time it I was given less than 24 hours notice that it would be delayed again. The day before they had confirmed it would be fine.They ended up using a local electrical contractor to do the work and gave them the incorrect information. The guys who actually did the install have done a fine job but unfortunately they don't usually contract to the solar sales company.It would also be good if this company and others actually detailed the steps and processes that have to occur once the installation is completed. Don't think because the system is running your on solar. It may take up to 5 weeks to have the next two steps completed. These are done by the retailer and the energy provider and not the company you purchase the system from. But it would be good if they actually told you these additional steps as part of their sales process.No, I would not recommend Always Energy

Sales and quoting process was very good and informativeInstallation went well - very polite and punctual - kept informing me how far away they were before arrivingWe had a different way of interpreting expressions like "ready to use" - I thought "ready to use" would mean it was ready to start exporting KW however what it meant was "ready to use once meter was replaced"I have contacted the company to change over the meter and have a date for installation - my only disappointment is the solar system will be installed for 21 days before the meter is replaced and the system can actually start operating and exporting KW.At all time Always Energy have answered my emails promptly.
Did the work within a week of accepting quoteInstallers worked non stop.System operating very well since.

Always energy were great to deal with. Spoke with the owner himself to discuss my needs and he was fantastic. Always quick to respond and willing to listen. Had a minor issue that was resolved quickly. Appreciate it! They took care of everything, all the paperwork and the grid connection etc. Made the process easy for us normal folk!

The purchasing process was easy they were very helpfulPrice was not the cheapest but was competitiveInstallation was quick and efficient the installation crew were friendly and helpfulAfter sales service was satisfactory as we had a battery failure after 4 days and the warranty process took a week to resolveOnce the warranty was approved replacement was quick and trouble free
1) Easy, well informed.2) Wasn't there, I was at work.3) They were brilliant, they did everything for me.
Customer service has been ok, still have troubles with connecting inverter to home Wi-Fi for monitoring purposes.
Excellent customer service from first consult through to setting up monitoring of energy savings.

Friendly and prompt quoting.Installation crew were punctual, polite and courteous.Still in the process of getting grid connection. Panels and inverter installed but not grid connected. Apparently with Origin Energy to be configured.
Always Energy was very similar with quote but was the only one that came out to inspect and quoteThey arrived one time and completed a very neat tidy jobthey organised grid connection

I rate Always Energy highly.  Competitive prices are offered on very good quality panels and inverter. These were installed with little fuss and  with no problems encountered in about six hours.  Customer service was polite and prompt. My 7.7kw system is capturing more energy than I am using now, even on rainy/overcast days. Recommended.

We found that dealing with Always Energy , the staff, and tradesmen, was  1 st. class in all aspects of their work.I would have no hesitation in recommending their services from quotation to implementation of the installation, to prospected customers, whom I am sure would be well satisfied, as we are.We only await the final grid connection with the power supply co. to finalise the contract, then all will be well.
Great service from Daniel, came on the day arranged many weeks before and am happy with the end result so far.
